name: wisp
title: Wisp
description: Every inbox you keep in Wisp (github.com/zcag/wisp), WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, Telegram, SMS and the rest, in one place: read and answer a conversation with Wisp's summary and suggested reply, write to anyone, make it a To do or mark it done, search every account at once, and see what is unread per network on the bar.
author: pal

settings.label: Wisp server
settings.description: The address of your Wisp server, as you open it in a browser.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: A token from Wisp's Accounts › Agent tokens with the scope App of yours, so what you do here acts as you, like Wisp's own page. A Read + send token works too, but acts as an agent: it sends and marks read only on accounts that let agents act. Kept in the OS keychain.

settings.label: Opening reads
settings.text: Opening a conversation marks it read, here and on its network
settings.description: As in Wisp: read means handled. Off, a conversation stays unread until cmd+u or m.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Every account's conversations in one list, as Wisp sorts them: the Inbox (unread and To dos that are due) under Wisp's sections, or Now, To do, the Screener and All; each row with its picture, last line, unread count or To do, and the latest messages in the pane.

keys.title: Mark read (unread on a read one)
Send the message typed after Tab
To do (clear it on a To do)

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Every recent conversation on every account, newest first, so a name typed at pal's root reaches the chat: the picture, the last line, the unread count or the To do, the latest messages and Wisp's summary in the pane.

keys.title: Mark read (unread on a read one)
Send the message typed after Tab
To do (clear it on a To do)

new.title: New Message
new.description: Write to anyone in Wisp's people, everyone you have talked with on every network: pick the person, then the account to write from (the conversation you already have with them first) and the message.

keys.title: Write to them (their conversation, or a new one)

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: One conversation to read and answer: Wisp's summary on top, the messages by day, theirs and yours, photos inline, a voice message's words, reactions, a mail's subject; a message field that sends on Enter, filled with Wisp's suggested reply on cmd+shift+d; a cursor over the messages to reply to one or react; follows new messages live. Opened bare, the newest in the Inbox.

keys.title: Suggest a reply into the field
The cursor to the previous message (cmd+down the next)
Reply to the message under the cursor (cmd+backspace stops)
To do (clear it on a To do)

search.title: Search Wisp
search.description: Every message on every account, in Wisp's search language: words as prefixes, "phrases", -exclusions, from:, in:whatsapp, is:unread, has:attachment, before: and after:.

keys.title: Open in Wisp at this message

accounts.title: Wisp Accounts
accounts.description: Each account Wisp connects with its state (connected, degraded, needs setup) and unread count, the ones that need attention first.

unread.description: Unread conversations, the number on Wisp's badge

for_me.description: Unread conversations with something meant for you: a mention, a reply in a thread you follow

trouble.description: Accounts that need attention: degraded, disconnected, waiting on setup

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Unread per network as each network's glyph and count in its colour (or per account, or one count after Wisp's own glyph), a red @ count while something is meant for you, To dos that are due; the popover is every account's inbox behind a tab per network: open a conversation, reply, mark read, To do or done without leaving it.

store.tagline: Every inbox you keep in Wisp, read and answered from pal
features: Every account Wisp connects (WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, Telegram, SMS, Instagram, LinkedIn, X) in one list, under Wisp's own sections and views: Inbox, Now, To do, the Screener, All
Any conversation reached by name from pal's root, and a new message to anyone in Wisp's people, from the account you choose
A conversation to read and answer inside pal: messages by day, photos inline, reactions, a field that sends on Enter, new messages as they arrive
Wisp's AI in the conversation: its summary on top, a suggested reply in the field on a key, a voice message's words; reply to one message or react to it
To do, To do tomorrow, Waiting on them, Done and read or unread on a key, over many conversations at once
One bar item: each network's glyph and unread count in its colour, a red @ for mentions meant for you, To dos that are due
Its popover is the whole inbox behind a tab per network: open, preview, reply, mark read, To do or done without opening anything
Wisp's search across every account, with from:, in:, is:unread and dates
Each account's state, the ones that need attention first, on the strip's popover and in Wisp Accounts
Follows Wisp's event stream, so the counts and an open conversation move as messages come in
Built on Wisp's integration API with a token that acts as you; github.com/zcag/wisp

screenshots.caption: Every account's inbox in one list, under Wisp's sections: the picture, the last line, the unread count in the network's colour, a To do that is due
The pane: the latest messages of the conversation, its account and what is unread
Enter opens the conversation: messages by day, the photo inline, a field that sends on Enter; cmd+t makes it a To do, cmd+e marks it done
⌘K on a conversation: read or unread, send a message, To do, tomorrow, waiting on them, done, open in Wisp
On the menu bar: an @ count for mentions meant for you, each network's glyph with its unread count, the To dos that are due
A click opens every inbox behind a tab per network: Enter opens a conversation, r replies, m marks read, t makes a To do, e marks it done
A group conversation in the popover, each sender named, answered without opening pal
On sketchybar: the same counts, each network in its colour and the @ in red
